-- query: SC-3 end-of-day report (missing index)
Aggregate  (cost=1890.00..1890.01 rows=1 width=8)
  ->  Seq Scan on sales  (cost=0.00..1750.00 rows=56000 width=4)
        Filter: ((store_id = 1) AND (sold_at >= '2026-11-07'::date))
